about: Background loops for the homepage and the main UI surfaces (console CINEMA). One entry per slot; to replace a slot's footage, drop the new files in this folder and edit that entry — see docs/home-backgrounds.md. kind is "in-game" (recorded from this platform's own worlds) or "licensed" (third-party footage: credit and licence are then required and the credit is shown on the page).
